// Required additions on normal inference and exported contracts, from the tarball.
import {
  connect,
  type Access,
  type AccessWithPages,
  type Connection,
  type ConnectionWithLabels,
  type IssueEvent,
  type IssueTracker,
  type IssueTrackerWithLabels,
  type Label,
  type PlatformEvent,
  type TransportRequest,
  type TransportResponse,
} from "@lutzseverino/postern";

const concrete = connect("https://github.com/octo/hello");
export const event = concrete.issueTracker.issueEvent({ name: "issues", payload: {} });
export const pages = concrete.access.requestPages({ path: "/repos/octo/hello/labels" });
export const labels = concrete.issueTracker.labels();
export const updated = concrete.issueTracker.updateLabel("old", {
  name: "new", color: "abcdef", description: "",
});

type Equal<A, B> =
  (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false;
type Assert<T extends true> = T;
export type EventResult = Assert<Equal<typeof event, Promise<IssueEvent | null>>>;
export type PagesResult = Assert<Equal<typeof pages, Promise<TransportResponse[]>>>;
export type LabelsResult = Assert<Equal<typeof labels, Promise<Label[]>>>;
export type UpdatedResult = Assert<Equal<typeof updated, Promise<Label>>>;

// Enhanced concrete values and named contracts still satisfy the legacy ports.
export const oldConnection: Connection = concrete;
export const oldTracker: IssueTracker = concrete.issueTracker;
export const oldAccess: Access = concrete.access;
export const enhanced: ConnectionWithLabels = concrete;
export const tracker: IssueTrackerWithLabels = concrete.issueTracker;
export const access: AccessWithPages = concrete.access;

interface RequiredTracker {
  issueEvent(event: PlatformEvent): Promise<IssueEvent | null>;
  labels(): Promise<Label[]>;
  updateLabel(name: string, label: Label): Promise<Label>;
}
interface RequiredAccess {
  requestPages(request: TransportRequest): Promise<TransportResponse[]>;
}

export type TrackerSignatures = Assert<Equal<
  Pick<IssueTrackerWithLabels, keyof RequiredTracker>, RequiredTracker
>>;
export type AccessSignatures = Assert<Equal<
  Pick<AccessWithPages, keyof RequiredAccess>, RequiredAccess
>>;

// Structural assignments fail if an exported contract drops or optionalizes a method.
export function harness(
  tracker: IssueTrackerWithLabels,
  access: AccessWithPages,
  connection: ConnectionWithLabels,
) {
  const requiredTracker: RequiredTracker = tracker;
  const requiredAccess: RequiredAccess = access;
  const requiredConnection: {
    readonly issueTracker: RequiredTracker;
    readonly access: RequiredAccess;
  } = connection;
  const legacyTracker: IssueTracker = tracker;
  const legacyAccess: Access = access;
  const legacyConnection: Connection = connection;
  return {
    event: requiredTracker.issueEvent({ name: "issues", payload: {} }),
    labels: requiredTracker.labels(),
    updated: requiredTracker.updateLabel("old", { name: "new", color: "abcdef", description: "" }),
    pages: requiredAccess.requestPages({ path: "/labels" }),
    requiredConnection,
    legacyTracker,
    legacyAccess,
    legacyConnection,
  };
}
